note:
The household of Warren Bowers, tea dealer and wine merchant, at Ravine House, 21 Lenton Road (#190), on the 1891 return, transcribed by A. Hagues as Bowens. Wright's Directory of Nottingham prints '21 Ravine house, Warren Bowers, of Bowers & Son' on Lenton Road in 1894-95, so the directory's spelling is used here and the transcribed Bowens is noted on each record; check it against the image. None of the five was in the record.

Ravine House already holds an 1891 household in the record: William Ebenezer Dobson, his wife and daughter. Wright's Directory prints William E. Dobson, J.P., at 23 Lenton Road in 1894-95 and 1898-99, not 21, so that 1891 filing looks wrong and wants checking against the Dobsons' own return; it is not moved here. Ages are as the enumerator wrote them, so a birth year worked back from one may be a year out either way.
source: 1891 census, Ravine House, Lenton Road, transcribed by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1894-95, page 84 (Leicester Special Collections id 164590); 1898-99, page 92 (id 165268).
